info.name: Returns all possible connections between two chains.

params.name: fromChain
params.description: The chain that should be the start of the possible connections.

params.name: toChain
params.description: The chain that should be the end of the possible connections.

params.name: fromToken
params.description: Only return connections starting with this token.

params.name: toToken
params.description: Only return connections ending with this token.

params.name: chainTypes
params.description: Restrict the resulting connections to the given chainTypes. Available values: EVM, SVM, UTXO, MVM, TVM.

params.name: allowBridges
params.description: List of bridges that are allowed for this transaction. Retrieve the current catalog from the `/v1/tools` endpoint.

params.name: denyBridges
params.description: List of bridges that are not allowed for this transaction. Retrieve the current catalog from the `/v1/tools` endpoint.

params.name: preferBridges
params.description: List of bridges that should be preferred for this transaction. Retrieve the current catalog from the `/v1/tools` endpoint.

params.name: allowExchanges
params.description: List of exchanges that are allowed for this transaction. Retrieve the current catalog from the `/v1/tools` endpoint.

params.name: denyExchanges
params.description: List of exchanges that are not allowed for this transaction. Retrieve the current catalog from the `/v1/tools` endpoint.

params.name: preferExchanges
params.description: List of exchanges that should be preferred for this transaction. Retrieve the current catalog from the `/v1/tools` endpoint.

params.name: allowSwitchChain
params.description: Whether connections that require chain switch should be included in the response.

params.name: allowDestinationCall
params.description: Whether connections that includes destination call should be included in the response.

items.docs:
This endpoint gives information about all possible transfers between chains.
`fromChain` and `toChain` are required. Additional filters such as token, bridge, and exchange can be used to narrow the result further.
Information about which chains and tokens are supported can be taken from the response of the /v1/chains endpoint.
Information about which bridges and exchanges are supported can be taken from the response of the `/v1/tools` endpoint.
